name: smwmusic-crash-team-racing-ready-to-rumble-all-variations
title: Crash Team Racing - Ready to Rumble (All Variations)
description:
The main theme of Crash Team Racing, which comes in three variations.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want:
0 = Intro Cutscene (features a distinct muted guitar and cymbal sample, doesn't have brass instruments, is slightly shorter in some parts and loops back to the intro)
1 = Win Race (has an additional brass channel in the intro)
2 = Lose Race (features a distinct, sad intro)
